response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior engineer with 15+ years across web, embedded, and high-performance systems, deep open-source involvement, and Linux/DevOps exposure — all relevant to the technical side of the role. However, the position is an executive-level leadership role in German IT consulting, and he lists German only at 'Basic' against a hard C1 requirement, which would block client advisory work. He also lacks formal people-leadership or technical project management experience (no team lead/head-of role), and shows no evidence of UML modeling, requirements management, IT security/compliance, or Python. Strong candidate for a senior IC role, but not a fit for Head of Development as specified.
strengths: 15+ years broad, hands-on engineering across many stacks
Deep open-source and Linux/DevOps involvement (GISCollective, D libraries)
Proven knowledge sharing: workshops, talks, courses
concerns: No formal team leadership or project management role
No evidence of UML, architecture design, or IT security/compliance work

key_factors.factor: Broad senior engineering and open-source depth
